hypothesis: A fixed first-half gate/up FP4 overlay may preserve fidelity while recovering enough prefill throughput for Gate A.
falsifier: Failure of any absolute Gate A, paired tail/capability, route/resource, or fatal-runtime condition yields no_go.

decision_rules.accept: Pass only if every frozen Gate A condition passes.
decision_rules.reject: Any failed Gate A condition is no_go and consumes opportunity three.
decision_rules.futility: Stop scoring after a deterministic hard-axis failure is proven.
decision_rules.abort: Abort on identity drift, OOM, engine death, fallback, or failed restore.
